bootstrap_joint.metric: RMSE_JOINT - RMSE_RESP (raw units, Val molecules resampled with replacement)
bootstrap_joint.note: Molecule-row resampling at the two fixed best-Val training states; it describes sample uncertainty, not training-seed variability.

compressed_candidate_mass.note: The three Lipo tau classes hold 442+81+91=614 of 702 Train candidates (~87.5%), so '13/16 classes stored exactly' is a class-count statement, not evidence that the compressed structure is small. Class count, candidate count, actual view frequency and held-out structure coverage are different quantities.

latent_text_mismatch.parent_report_text: D_LATENT described as farthest-first in the latent k(S) space
latent_text_mismatch.resolution: This round uses the implementation as fact ([a(S), q(S)]). The parent experiment is not re-run for a wording difference.

corrections.note_epoch: Comparing RESP epoch 63 Train RMSE with ADD epoch 91 Train RMSE is not a fit diagnostic: the two selected states are different points on different curves. At the same epoch RESP also has the lower Train RMSE (63: 0.3475 vs 0.3788; 91: 0.2797 vs 0.3018; 360: 0.0835 vs 0.1002), so a fitting/optimisation component cannot be excluded from the S0 Lipo RESP-vs-ADD difference.

alpha.convergence_note: 64 Frank-Wolfe steps are the frozen budget; a class left at 64 steps is reported as limited, not re-run with more iterations.

decision.label: RESPONSE_SELECTOR_ADVANTAGE_AT_THIS_RATE
decision.note: 20% fidelity reduction is this round's investment reference only; a small difference is reported as is and never called equivalence.

panel_intervention.note: Frozen-model intervention on the best-Val RESP state. a(S), b(C), q(S), w and every fallback path are unchanged; only the environment-dependent factor k(C) inside the fusion term is replaced by its class panel mean. This checks whether the trained function uses environment variation at all; it is not a generalisation test.

replay.note: Replay uses the frozen checkpoint and the parent dictionary code; differences are float64 round-off only.

response_dimensions.note: Response-dimension statistics of the frozen reference (D0) and the 16-environment Train panel; they describe this reference/panel, not the structural complexity of the data.

labels.note: Held-out edit support is 7 Test components and 4 Valid components; per the frozen rule (component count < 20) all held-out cells are LOW_SUPPORT and descriptive only.

mapping.note: The catalogue's own split_a/split_b columns are not used: the official split is re-derived from the mapped OGB row id. row_a/row_b are kept only as a cross-check.

edits.note: Train-Train pairs share a Train endpoint with the training set; they are not held-out evidence. The only non-Train supports are the 27 Train-Test and 5 Train-Valid pairs, which are 7/4 Test/Valid molecules inside 7/4 components. This diagnostic cannot establish a chemical task law and is not a model-selection criterion.

labels.product_form_note: RESP beats the matched joint MLP by at least the pre-declared 0.02 Val margin, Test follows and the sign survives removing the single most favourable Val molecule.

matched_epochs.note: Matched-epoch numbers from the committed per-epoch curves. They show that the selected-state comparison is not only an epoch-choice effect on Val, but they also show it is not epoch-invariant on Test (at epoch 85, JOINT's best-Val epoch, Test is 0.6999 for JOINT vs 0.7095 for RESP while Val is 0.6555 vs 0.6642).
